title: Plain payload is caught (control)
note: if this is not 'injection' the whole corpus is invalid

title: Appended analytical words discount the whole text
note: mitigators are whole-text booleans and multiply; payload bytes unchanged (the minimal suffix in this fixture is 4 words)

title: A leading negation word discounts the live payload
note: the negation mitigator fires on the whole text, not near the match

title: Payload placed past the first scan window
note: this input is caught: the library scan() reads the input in overlapping windows up to MAX_SCAN_CHARS and returns the highest-scoring window's verdict. Not closed as a class: a payload beyond MAX_SCAN_CHARS is not inspected (the verdict is flagged truncated). The CLI refuses input longer than one window with exit 3

title: Base64 with the padding stripped
note: this input is caught: the padding is restored before decoding

title: Base64 split by a newline into two blobs
note: this input is caught: whitespace-separated base64 tokens are rejoined before decoding. Not closed as a class: a broken blob behind 16 decoy tokens, and a blob longer than the window overlap on a window seam, are still missed (see the list under the table)

title: Doubly-encoded base64
note: this input is caught: decoded output is decoded again, up to B64_MAX_DEPTH layers. Not closed as a class: a payload nested deeper than the cap is not decoded
